English Translation from DLsite

I bought this to see how well I did with my personal translation I did using AI translators. They were about 96% correct with the words and phrases they gave, I did do some editing to my own so it wasn't 100% AI, and that made it almost word for word to this official translation I'm uploading.

I made the gallery category Manga(instead of Doujinshi like the other uploads) since that's what it's listed as on DLsite and what the creator called it on page 4.

If you like it buy a copy and show the creator you want to see it continued.
